high_level_description: The image shows a Dell computer screen displaying an "Automatic Repair" message. The screen is predominantly blue with white text. The text reads: "Automatic Repair" Below that, it states: "Your PC did not start correctly. Press 'Restart' to restart your PC, which can sometimes fix the problem. You can also press 'Advanced options' to try other options to repair your PC." There are two buttons at the bottom of the screen labeled "Restart" and "Advanced options." In the background, partially visible through the reflection on the screen, there appears to be a person wearing a pink shirt.
